parameters.name: query
parameters.value: =MATCH (c:Campaign {id: '{{ $json.campaignId }}' }) RETURN c.worldState as worldState, c.politicalLandscape as politicalContext, c.factionHistory as factionHistory

parameters.name: messages
query
parameters.value: =MATCH (c:Campaign {id: '{{ $json.campaignId }}' })-[r:CONTAINS_FACTION]->(f:Faction {id: '{{ $json.factionId }}' }) SET f = {{ JSON.stringify($json.world_updates.updated_faction) }}, c.lastFactionUpdate = '{{ $json.timestamp }}' RETURN f, r

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { success: true, operation_id: $json.operation_id, action_completed: true, success: $json.action_summary.success, narrative_summary: $json.action_summary.narrative_summary.description, player_opportunities: $json.action_summary.campaign_implications.player_opportunities, next_steps: $json.action_summary.next_steps, world_changes: $json.action_summary.action_summary.world_changes } }}
